sections.name: K-12 Curriculum Standards Library
sections.purpose: A research-backed, version-controlled library comparing Florida standards, Arizona standards and IB frameworks for Kindergarten through Grade 12 in ELA, mathematics, science and social studies. It feeds the AI Learning Primer.
sections.status: Phase 0 scaffold. No standards content collected yet. Active scope: Grades 2-8 (K and Grade 1 omitted; Grades 9-12 deferred).

content_labels.B: Official IB framework or programme requirement
content_labels.C: Suggested alignment, unit idea, instructional bridge or summary written by us. Never official.

sections.critical_distinction: Florida and Arizona publish grade-level standards. IB is a programme framework, not a grade-by-grade checklist. IB grade placement here is our convention (PYP K-5, MYP 6-10, DP/CP 11-12) and is Label C unless an official IB source says otherwise.
quality_rules: Official sources only: fldoe.org, cdn.fldoe.org, cpalms.org, azed.gov, ibo.org.
Record URL, title, version date, page and access date for every source.
Never reconstruct restricted IB content from memory.
Never claim Florida and Arizona standards are equivalent because the wording is similar.
Flag standards that do not map cleanly.
Every document carries its own citations.
Instructional bridges are practical but always Label C.
No PDF or Word output until the JSON is reviewed.
sections.envelope: Every document has: schema_version, doc_id, doc_type, system, programme, grade, grade_label, subject, status, content_labels, sections, citations, version_notes, last_updated. See templates/.

folder_map.bundle.json: GENERATED by tools/build_bundle.py. Never edit by hand.
folder_map.tools/build_bundle.py: Validates every document and writes bundle.json
folder_map.sources/: Official-source registers for Florida, Arizona, IB, plus a version log
folder_map.florida/<grade>/<subject>.json: Official Florida standards (Label A) plus our summaries (C)
folder_map.ib/pyp | myp | dp-cp/<grade>/<subject>.j: IB alignment documents. PYP: kindergarten, grade-01..05. MYP: grade-06..10. DP/CP: grade-11, grade-12
folder_map.grade folder names: kindergarten, grade-01 ... grade-12. Subjects: ela, mathematics, science, social-studies.

primer_consumption.load: Read bundle.json once at build or startup. documents is an object keyed by doc_id.
primer_consumption.lookup: Compute ids: fl.grade-03.ela, az.grade-03.ela, ib.pyp.grade-03.ela, xw.grade-03.ela. Use inventory to list what exists and each document's status.
trust_rules: Treat only status reviewed or approved as ready for learners; drafted is for internal use.
Use label A and B content for factual claims about what a standard or framework requires.
Always show label C content as suggestion. Never present it as official.
Preserve standard ids exactly when storing mastery against standards.
primer_consumption.relation_to_existing_seeds: The existing TypeScript SubjectSeed files (Florida Grades 3-5) keep working. A later step can generate seeds from verified library documents.
